content.title: Russia's Military Losses and Mortality Patterns
content.caption: Russia's own figures reveal the full-scale invasion of Ukraine has fundamentally changed mortality patterns in the country.

slides.heading: Russia's Military Losses and Mortality Patterns
slides.text: Russia's own figures reveal the full-scale invasion of Ukraine has fundamentally changed mortality patterns in the country.

slides.heading: What Happened
slides.text: The war in Ukraine has led to a significant increase in mortality rates in Russia.

slides.heading: Why Matters
slides.text: The data shows that 65% of 18-24 year-olds in Russia who lost their lives in 2025 died in the war.
